comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (67.65%) to CRAMP-1 K: 18%, L=E: 15%. GRAVY: -0.83; Mol Wt: 3904.6; mol formula: C178H297N49O48. Activity: Active against E.coli ATCC8739 (MIC 150 ug/ml), A. baumannii ATCC19606 (MIC 75 ug/ml), P. aeruginosa ATCC27853 (MIC 37.5 ug/ml), and S. aureus ATCC6538 (MIC 75 ug/ml). Structure: random coil in water and helical in 8 mM SDS micelles (57%). In vitro toxicity: human RBC: no hemolysis at 100 ug/ml, not hemo.lytic. Not toxic to HaCaT cells at 100 ug/ml.
title: TC-14, a cathelicidin-derived antimicrobial peptide with broad-spectrum antibacterial activity and high safety profile
